detail.longDescription: Why real-time AI at scale is so hard Real-time AI at scale struggles more with data pipelines than models. Key issues: tail latency spikes under traffic, stale features killing accuracy, and vector index maintenance. Resource contention between training/serving complicates things. Solution: robust infrastructure with monitoring, workload isolation, and consistent retraining. Separated vector indexing and high-performance databases help prevent performance degradation. https:// thenewstack.io/real-time-ai-sc ale/ # AI # MachineLearning
